features.feature: The Windows build and per-user MSI are produced; install and first run work
A Teams call is recorded (Teams' output device as the other side) and transcribed
The window works on Windows (Echo's own title bar by default, the native one when turned off; Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P, Ctrl+Shift+U for the Inbox)
Start at sign-in, quit and `echoctl` on the user PATH
Updates install from the release MSI only with a matching digest
Mute sync, Teams UI text, notifications, the tray icon and shared-screen frames work on Windows

Echo's own title bar (on by default, off in Settings → Layout; Windows only): no system frame, the strip moves, maximises and resizes the window and holds minimise, maximise and close; on or off at once
